verdicts.reason: A keeps the quote mark and quote together as a clear top block, but the attribution is enlarged until it competes with the quote. The logo floats loose at mid-right, and the can and circle are pushed into a cramped lower-left corner. B leaves a large dead gap between the quote mark and the quote, which is pushed toward the bottom edge. Its text runs into the circle's edge, the can sits awkwardly on the circle's rim at top-right, and the logo is jammed beside a tiny attribution, so the layout feels unbalanced and unplanned.
